label: Qatiq
note: Boiled milk fermented 6-10 h in a warm place; denser than ayran; strained gives suzma, dried suzma is kurut; used in the Uzbek chalop soup

about.text: A fermented milk of the Turkic countries and Bulgaria, a more solid yoghurt than ayran, made from boiled milk left warm for 6-10 hours.
